{{Quote|We saw his Z-95 on the way in. Not sure where he put down, but from the vector he was on I'd say he was somewhere between bays fifty-two and fifty-eight''"<br />"''It's fifty-six. Blast it, Solo. You weren't supposed to know he was along.|Han Solo and Vestin Axlon|<ref name="COO">''[[Choices of One]]''</ref>}}
'''Bay Fifty-two''' was a landing bay within [[Whitestone City spaceport]] in [[Whitestone City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Poln Major]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> during a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Battle for Poln Major|mission]] to the planet, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] correctly estimated that his friend [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] had secretly docked his [[Z-95-AF4 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] somewhere between Bays Fifty-Two and [[Bay fifty-eight|Fifty-Eight]]. Solo's passenger, the [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] [[Vestin Axlon]], then revealed the exact bay number.<ref name="COO" />
